typography.display: Noto Sans SC / Microsoft YaHei UI / PingFang SC / Segoe UI
typography.body: Noto Sans SC / Microsoft YaHei UI / PingFang SC / Segoe UI

color.background: Near-black neutral canvas with a cool central spotlight
color.text: Soft white primary labels and cool-gray secondary labels
color.accent: Selective cyan, violet, green, coral and amber gradients live inside icon tiles only

shared_visual_core.material: Dark matte canvas, restrained center glow, soft white icon tiles and thin cool-gray outlines
shared_visual_core.shape_and_line: One large rounded-square hero mark and eight equal tall cards with consistent corner radii and one-pixel outlines
shared_visual_core.image_treatment: All marks are original HTML/CSS/inline SVG geometry; the reference supplies composition and tonal strategy, not brands or trademark artwork
shared_visual_core.hierarchy_and_rhythm: Hero mark, centered single-line title, then a four-column by two-row directory whose English and Chinese labels share fixed baselines

static_composition.capacity: Eight directory items arranged as four equal columns by two equal rows
static_composition.hero: A centered 200px rounded-square mark establishes the collection identity without becoming a product logo
static_composition.labels: Each card uses one compact English primary label and one shorter Chinese secondary label
static_composition.thumbnail: At 360px width the title, all eight icon tiles and the two-level label rhythm remain distinguishable
